Vendored browser libraries (served locally, no CDN requests at runtime):

- markdown-it 14.1.0: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it — MIT, see markdown-it.LICENSE.
- Highlight.js 11.11.1 common browser build: https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release — BSD-3-Clause, see highlight.LICENSE.

Codex and reviewer responses use Markdown with raw HTML disabled. Known fenced code languages receive syntax highlighting; unknown languages remain escaped code. User messages and activity logs preserve their original text.
